scope: same-source diagnostic candidate filter only; not v19 or exact-Leopard1 authority
contamination: Stop and retain failure on any non-idle sibling jiffy across an invocation; do not analyze a partial attempt or change CPUs/retry based on timings.
integrity: Canonical lock and physical pair lease; freeze newly linked executables and full archives with SHA256 before first measurement and recheck after every invocation; all input/output hashes, route and scratch must match untimed preflight. No build while measuring.
resources: One process at a time; builds512MiB-j1; checks/timing256MiB; swap0; prlimit CPU30seconds per child and output1MiB; controller pinnedCPU0, childrenCPU4.
analysis: Process median of21 samples; round ratio sqrt(off0*off3/(on1*on2)); geometric mean of3round ratios. Keep raw samples. No confidence interval, trimming, pooling, or statistical retry.
decision: Only if every unchanged control aggregate is inside[1/1.02,1.02] may candidate filtering proceed. Continue to future qualification only if a target aggregate reaches1.05 with all its rounds>1 and every neighbor aggregate>=1/1.02. Otherwise reject for this screen, or mark inconclusive when controls fail. No result authorizes production promotion or an exact-Leopard1 claim.
